INSERT IGNORE INTO monthly_ticket_season (period_code, season_type, zone_id, start_at, end_at, vote_cutoff_at, status, policy_version, runtime_config_revision) VALUES (#{periodCode}, #{seasonType}, #{zoneId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{voteCutoffAt}, 'OPEN', #{policyVersion}, #{runtimeConfigRevision})
mapper.select: SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, season_type AS seasonType, zone_id AS zoneId, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion, runtime_config_revision AS runtimeConfigRevision, snapshot_id AS snapshotId, closing_at AS closingAt, review_at AS reviewAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE period_code = #{periodCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, season_type AS seasonType, zone_id AS zoneId, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion, runtime_config_revision AS runtimeConfigRevision, snapshot_id AS snapshotId, closing_at AS closingAt, review_at AS reviewAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE season_type = 'REGULAR' AND start_at <= #{at} AND end_at > #{at} ORDER BY start_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, season_type AS seasonType, zone_id AS zoneId, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion, runtime_config_revision AS runtimeConfigRevision, snapshot_id AS snapshotId, closing_at AS closingAt, review_at AS reviewAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE season_type = 'REGULAR' ORDER BY start_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, season_type AS seasonType, zone_id AS zoneId, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion, runtime_config_revision AS runtimeConfigRevision, snapshot_id AS snapshotId, closing_at AS closingAt, review_at AS reviewAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND start_at <= #{at} AND vote_cutoff_at > #{at} ORDER BY (season_type = 'REGULAR') DESC, vote_cutoff_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, season_type AS seasonType, zone_id AS zoneId, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion, runtime_config_revision AS runtimeConfigRevision, snapshot_id AS snapshotId, closing_at AS closingAt, review_at AS reviewAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND vote_cutoff_at <= #{at} ORDER BY vote_cutoff_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, season_type AS seasonType, zone_id AS zoneId, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion, runtime_config_revision AS runtimeConfigRevision, snapshot_id AS snapshotId, closing_at AS closingAt, review_at AS reviewAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE status = 'CLOSING' ORDER BY closing_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: id, season_id AS seasonId, sequence_no AS sequenceNo, status, cutoff_at AS cutoffAt, entry_count AS entryCount, total_tickets AS totalTickets, content_hash AS contentHash, sealed_at AS sealedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM monthly_rank_snapshot WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND sequence_no = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM monthly_rank_snapshot WHERE id = #{snapshotId} AND sequence_no = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT aggregate.book_id AS bookId, ( SELECT latest.author_id FROM monthly_ticket_vote latest WHERE latest.season_id = #{seasonId} AND latest.book_id = aggregate.book_id AND latest.status = 'VALID' AND latest.create_time < #{cutoffAt} ORDER BY latest.create_time DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS authorId, aggregate.total_tickets AS totalTickets, aggregate.distinct_voter_count AS distinctVoterCount, aggregate.last_vote_at AS lastVoteAt FROM ( SELECT vote.book_id, SUM(vote.ticket_count) AS total_tickets, COUNT(DISTINCT vote.user_id) AS distinct_voter_count, MAX(vote.create_time) AS last_vote_at FROM monthly_ticket_vote vote WHERE vote.season_id = #{seasonId} AND vote.status = 'VALID' AND vote.create_time < #{cutoffAt} GROUP BY vote.book_id ) aggregate ORDER BY aggregate.total_tickets DESC, aggregate.distinct_voter_count DESC, aggregate.last_vote_at ASC, aggregate.book_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO monthly_rank_entry (snapshot_id, rank_no, book_id, author_id, total_tickets, distinct_voter_count, last_vote_at) VALUES
(#{row.snapshotId}, #{row.rankNo}, #{row.bookId}, #{row.authorId}, #{row.totalTickets}, #{row.distinctVoterCount}, #{row.lastVoteAt})
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id AS snapshotId, rank_no AS rankNo, book_id AS bookId, author_id AS authorId, total_tickets AS totalTickets, distinct_voter_count AS distinctVoterCount, last_vote_at AS lastVoteAt FROM monthly_rank_entry WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND rank_no > #{afterRank} ORDER BY rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_rank_snapshot SET status = 'SEALED', entry_count = #{entryCount}, total_tickets = #{totalTickets}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, sealed_at = #{sealedAt} WHERE id = #{snapshotId} AND status = 'BUILDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO scheduled_job_run (job_type, scope_type, scope_key, status, owner_instance, heartbeat_at, started_at) VALUES (#{jobType}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, 'RUNNING', #{ownerInstance}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_job_run SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, owner_instance = #{ownerInstance}, heartbeat_at = #{claimedAt}, started_at = #{claimedAt}, finished_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE job_type = #{jobType} AND scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < #{staleBefore}))

UPDATE scheduled_job_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', heartbeat_at = #{finishedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_message = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE job_type = 'SEASON_SNAPSHOT' AND scope_type = 'SEASON' AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT counter.book_id AS bookId, book.author_id AS authorId, book.book_name AS bookName, COALESCE(author.pen_name, book.author_name) AS authorName, book.pic_url AS picUrl, counter.total_tickets AS totalTickets, counter.distinct_voter_count AS distinctVoterCount, counter.last_vote_at AS lastVoteAt FROM monthly_rank_counter counter JOIN book ON book.id = counter.book_id LEFT JOIN author ON author.id = book.author_id WHERE counter.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY counter.total_tickets DESC, counter.distinct_voter_count DESC, counter.last_vote_at ASC, counter.book_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT entry.snapshot_id AS snapshotId, entry.rank_no AS rankNo, entry.book_id AS bookId, entry.author_id AS authorId, book.book_name AS bookName, COALESCE(author.pen_name, book.author_name) AS authorName, book.pic_url AS picUrl, entry.total_tickets AS totalTickets, entry.distinct_voter_count AS distinctVoterCount, entry.last_vote_at AS lastVoteAt FROM monthly_rank_entry entry JOIN book ON book.id = entry.book_id LEFT JOIN author ON author.id = entry.author_id WHERE entry.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY entry.rank_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_job_run SET status = 'PAUSED', heartbeat_at = #{pausedAt}, finished_at = #{pausedAt}, error_message = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE job_type = 'SEASON_SNAPSHOT' AND scope_type = 'SEASON' AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'FAILED')
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO scheduled_job_run (job_type, scope_type, scope_key, status, owner_instance, heartbeat_at, started_at, finished_at, error_message) VALUES ('SEASON_SNAPSHOT', 'SEASON', #{scopeKey}, 'PAUSED', 'admin-pause', #{pausedAt}, #{pausedAt}, #{pausedAt}, #{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_job_run SET status = 'FAILED', heartbeat_at = #{resumedAt}, finished_at = #{resumedAt}, error_message = 'RETRY_REQUESTED_BY_ADMIN', version = version + 1 WHERE job_type = 'SEASON_SNAPSHOT' AND scope_type = 'SEASON' AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND status = 'PAUSED'
